title: Before you start
intro: InsideLabel only works if every photo is of a real pack. Each one is checked, by our rules and often by a person, before it joins the catalogue. Please agree to these few rules.
points: I am a real person using InsideLabel myself, not an automated program.
I will only photograph real packs that I am holding or that are in front of me.
I will not upload pictures made or changed by AI, edited photos, or screenshots of websites and apps.
I understand that what I send may be checked by a person, and that made-up or altered pictures are removed and can close my invite.
I understand that InsideLabel shows ingredient facts from the label. It is not medical advice.
